heading: Sunday Night
text: Widespread rain south, isolated north. Mild.

heading: Monday
text: Early showers likely, then lateday showers north.
temperature: Mid 60s to around 70, some lower 60s far north

heading: Tuesday
text: Showers spreading from north to south.
temperature: Upper 50s to lower 60s, some mid 60s far south

heading: Wednesday
text: Spotty localized showers, breaks of sun.
